title: Normalized Briefing Contract
description: Output schema for slide-chief briefing normalization. Produced by *normalize-briefing and consumed by content-architect, template-curator, and downstream agents.

topic.description: Explicit presentation topic. MUST be present -- halt intake if missing after 1 clarification.

objective.description: What should the audience DO, FEEL, or KNOW after this deck. MUST be present.

audience.description: Target audience. Inferred from context if missing, flagged for confirmation.

context.description: WHERE the presentation will be delivered. Determines mode selection.

duration_minutes.description: Estimated duration. Inferred from format defaults if not specified.

format.description: Presentation format. Determines mode override, slide count, and dominant types.

mode.description: Delivery mode. Determines word limits, whitespace, animation, safe zones.

aspect_ratio.description: Canvas aspect ratio. Default 16:9 for projector/monitor.

induction_mode.description: Template selection strategy. reference_first when screenshots/PPTX are present.

max_slides.description: Maximum slide count. Derived from format range or duration estimate.

brand_config_resolved.description: Whether brand config was resolved from workspace or briefing.

brand_config_source.description: Path or reference to the brand config source. Optional if brand_config_resolved=false.

source_materials_count.description: Number of source materials provided. 0 triggers briefing-only warnings.

reference_assets_count.description: Number of reference assets (screenshots, PPTX). >0 triggers reference_first mode.

blockers.description: Blocking issues that halt the pipeline. Must be empty to proceed.

education_mode.description: When true, activates andragogic rules in the pipeline (Mayer, Kolb, DPC, Dreyfus, Scaffolding). When false, pipeline operates identically to v1. Optional -- defaults to false for backward compatibility.

audience_profile.description: Detailed audience profile for Dreyfus-calibrated content. Complements (does not replace) the required 'audience' string field. Optional -- omit for non-educational decks.

dreyfus_level.description: Dreyfus model skill acquisition level. Determines max_variables, rule provision, example density, and vocabulary pre-training requirements.

context.description: Educational context: course name, training program, workshop setting, etc.

prior_knowledge.description: List of concepts/skills the audience already possesses. Used by K8 killer item to skip pre-training for known terms.

source_type.description: Origin of the briefing content. 'manual' = user-authored, 'document' = extracted from docs, 'youtube' = extracted from YouTube video, 'audio' = extracted from audio file. Optional -- defaults to 'manual' for backward compatibility with v1 briefings.

youtube_source.description: YouTube source metadata and adaptation decisions. Present only when source_type='youtube'. Consumed by content-architect (visual_moments for visual_strategy) and visual-scout (keyframe paths as reference_assets).

extraction_profile.description: Transcript source used during extraction. Maps to youtube-extraction.schema.json extraction_status.transcript_source.

chapters.description: Video chapters from extraction. Timestamps in float seconds.

adapted.description: Whether this chapter was adapted per user preferences.

visual_moments.description: Visual moments from video frame analysis. Consumed by content-architect framework_5 (Semantic Classification Engine) to inform visual_strategy when available. Filtered: speaker_only removed, confidence >= 0.3.

type.description: Visual content classification. 'speaker_only' excluded (filtered during extraction).

description.description: Textual description of the visual content.

text_content.description: OCR text from the frame when applicable.

frame_path.description: Relative path to the extracted keyframe.

confidence.description: Classification confidence (0.0 to 1.0). Minimum 0.3 after filtering.

adaptation.description: User adaptation preferences collected during youtube-to-briefing Stage 5 Q&A.

target_product.description: Product/service to adapt the content for. Original video content if user chose to keep as-is.

target_audience.description: Target audience for the adapted presentation.

tone_override.description: Tone preference: formal, conversational, technical, inspirational, etc.

keep_vs_adapt.description: 'keep' = use original content as-is, 'adapt' = transform for target product/audience, 'hybrid' = keep structure but adapt examples and context.

structure_decisions.description: Chapter-level decisions: which to keep, remove, or adapt.

_example.objective: Convince investors to fund Series A
